component.name: ZDL-Echo
component.summary: DTMF, MF (R1) and SF telecom signaling toolkit

description.p: ZDL-Echo is a telecom research and signaling toolkit for generating and decoding legacy tone signaling: DTMF (touch-tone dialing), R1 MF (inter-office multi-frequency), and SF (2600 Hz single-frequency supervisory tone). It includes a real-time oscilloscope view of the captured audio and a Goertzel-based tone decoder tuned to reject false positives from speech.
Intended for authorized diagnostics, telecom research, and education on legacy switch/PBX signaling only.
Settings persistence, an SF (2600 Hz) RX detection toggle, TX/RX log export, audio engine hardening for lower-latency PipeWire playback, and Linux packaging (DEB/RPM/Flatpak/tar.gz).
